1.mohsin_khan: Ya-Sin. [These letters are one of the miracles of the Quran, and none but Allah (Alone) knows their meanings.]

2.yusuf_ali: By the Qur'an, full of Wisdom,-
2.shakir: I swear by the Quran full of wisdom
2.muhammad_sarwar: and the Quran, the Book of wisdom,
2.mohsin_khan: By the Quran, full of wisdom (i.e. full of laws, evidences, and proofs),

3.sahih_international: Indeed you, [O Muhammad], are from among the messengers,
3.pickthall: Lo! thou art of those sent
3.yusuf_ali: Thou art indeed one of the messengers,
3.shakir: Most surely you are one of the apostles
3.mohsin_khan: Truly, you (O Muhammad SAW) are one of the Messengers,
3.arberry: thou art truly among the Envoys

4.muhammad_sarwar: and that you follow the right path.
4.mohsin_khan: On a Straight Path (i.e. on Allah's religion of Islamic Monotheism).

5.sahih_international: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
5.pickthall: A revelation of the Mighty, the Merciful,
5.yusuf_ali: It is a Revelation sent down by (Him), the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
5.shakir: A revelation of the Mighty, the Merciful.
5.muhammad_sarwar: This is a revelation sent down from the Majestic and All-merciful
5.mohsin_khan: (This is) a Revelation sent down by the AllMighty, the Most Merciful,
5.arberry: the sending down of the All-mighty, the All-wise,

6.sahih_international: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.
6.pickthall: That thou mayst warn a folk whose fathers were not warned, so they are heedless.
6.yusuf_ali: In order that thou mayest admonish a people, whose fathers had received no admonition, and who therefore remain heedless (of the Signs of Allah).
6.shakir: That you may warn a people whose fathers were not warned, so they are heedless.
6.muhammad_sarwar: so that you may warn a people who are unaware because their fathers were not warned.
6.mohsin_khan: In order that you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are heedless.
6.arberry: that thou mayest warn a people whose fathers were never warned, so they are heedless.

7.sahih_international: Already the word has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.
7.pickthall: Already hath the judgment, (for their infidelity) proved true of most of them, for they believe not.
7.yusuf_ali: The Word is proved true against the greater part of them: for they do not believe.
7.shakir: Certainly the word has proved true of most of them, so they do not believe.
7.muhammad_sarwar: (I swear) that most of them are doomed to be punished. They have no faith.
7.mohsin_khan: Indeed the Word (of punishment) has proved true against most of them, so they will not believe.
7.arberry: The Word has been realised against most of them, yet they do not believe.

8.sahih_international: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.
8.pickthall: Lo! We have put on their necks carcans reaching unto the chins, so that they are made stiff-necked.
8.yusuf_ali: We have put yokes round their necks right up to their chins, so that their heads are forced up (and they cannot see).
8.shakir: Surely We have placed chains on their necks, and these reach up to their chins, so they have their heads raised aloft.
8.muhammad_sarwar: We have enchained their necks up to their chins. Thus, they cannot bend their heads (to find their way).
8.mohsin_khan: Verily! We have put on their necks iron collars reaching to chins, so that their heads are forced up.
8.arberry: Surely We have put on their necks fetters up to the chin, so their heads are raised;

9.sahih_international: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.
9.pickthall: And We have set a bar before them and a bar behind them, and (thus) have covered them so that they see not.
9.yusuf_ali: And We have put a bar in front of them and a bar behind them, and further, We have covered them up; so that they cannot see.
9.shakir: And We have made before them a barrier and a barrier behind them, then We have covered them over so that they do not see.
9.muhammad_sarwar: We have set-up a barrier in front of and behind them and have made them blind. Thus, they cannot see.
9.mohsin_khan: And We have put a barrier before them, and a barrier behind them, and We have covered them up, so that they cannot see.
9.arberry: and We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier; and We have covered them, so they do not see.

10.sahih_international: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.
10.pickthall: Whether thou warn them or thou warn them not, it is alike for them, for they believe not.
10.yusuf_ali: The same is it to them whether thou admonish them or thou do not admonish them: they will not believe.
10.shakir: And it is alike to them whether you warn them or warn them not: they do not believe.
10.muhammad_sarwar: Whether you warn them or not, they will not believe.
10.mohsin_khan: It is the same to them whether you warn them or you warn them not, they will not believe.
10.arberry: Alike it is to them whether thou hast warned them or thou hast not warned them, they do not believe.

11.sahih_international: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.
11.pickthall: Thou warnest only him who followeth the Reminder and feareth the Beneficent in secret. To him bear tidings of forgiveness and a rich reward.
11.yusuf_ali: Thou canst but admonish such a one as follows the Message and fears the (Lord) Most Gracious, unseen: give such a one, therefore, good tidings, of Forgiveness and a Reward most generous.
11.shakir: You can only warn him who follows the reminder and fears the Beneficent Allah in secret; so announce to him forgiveness and an honorable reward.
11.muhammad_sarwar: You should only warn those who follow the Quran and have fear of the Beneficent God without seeing Him. Give them the glad news of their receiving forgiveness and an honorable reward (from God).
11.mohsin_khan: You can only warn him who follows the Reminder (the Quran), and fears the Most Beneficent (Allah) unseen. Bear you to such one the glad tidings of forgiveness, and a generous reward (i.e. Paradise).
11.arberry: Thou only warnest him who follows the Remembrance and who fears the All-merciful in the Unseen; so give him the good tidings of forgiveness and a generous wage.

12.sahih_international: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.
12.pickthall: Lo! We it is Who bring the dead to life. We record that which they send before (them, and their footprints. And all things We have kept in a clear Register.
12.yusuf_ali: Verily We shall give life to the dead, and We record that which they send before and that which they leave behind, and of all things have We taken account in a clear Book (of evidence).
12.shakir: Surely We give life to the dead, and We write down what they have sent before and their footprints, and We have recorded everything in a clear writing.
12.muhammad_sarwar: It is We who bring the dead to life and records the deeds of human beings and their consequences (of continual effects). We keep everything recorded in an illustrious Book.
12.mohsin_khan: Verily, We give life to the dead, and We record that which they send before (them), and their traces [their footsteps and walking on the earth with their legs to the mosques for the five compulsory congregational prayers, Jihad (holy fighting in Allah's Cause) and all other good and evil they did, and that which they leave behind], and all things We have recorded with numbers (as a record) in a Clear Book.
12.arberry: Surely it is We who bring the dead to life and write down what they have forwarded and what they have left behind; everything We have numbered in a clear register.

13.sahih_international: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -
13.pickthall: Coin for them a similitude: The people of the city when those sent (from Allah) came unto them;
13.yusuf_ali: Set forth to them, by way of a parable, the (story of) the Companions of the City. Behold!, there came messengers to it.
13.shakir: And set out to them an example of the people of the town, when the apostles came to it.
13.muhammad_sarwar: Tell them the story of the people of the town to whom Messengers came.
13.mohsin_khan: And put forward to them a similitude; the (story of the) dwellers of the town, [It is said that the town was Antioch (Antakiya)], when there came Messengers to them.
13.arberry: Strike for them a similitude -- the inhabitants of the city, when the Envoys came to it;

14.sahih_international: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened them with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."
14.pickthall: When We sent unto them twain, and they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third, and they said: Lo! we have been sent unto you.
14.yusuf_ali: When We (first) sent to them two messengers, they rejected them: But We strengthened them with a third: they said, "Truly, we have been sent on a mission to you."
14.shakir: When We sent to them two, they rejected both of them, then We strengthened (them) with a third, so they said: Surely we are apostles to you.
14.muhammad_sarwar: We sent them two Messengers whom they rejected. We supported them by sending a third one who told the people, "We are the Messengers (of God) who have been sent to you".
14.mohsin_khan: When We sent to them two Messengers, they belied them both, so We reinforced them with a third, and they said: "Verily! We have been sent to you as Messengers."
14.arberry: when We sent unto them two men, but they cried them lies, so We sent a third as reinforcement. They said, 'We are assuredly Envoys unto you.

15.sahih_international: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."
15.pickthall: They said: Ye are but mortals like unto us. The Beneficent hath naught revealed. Ye do but lie!
15.yusuf_ali: The (people) said: "Ye are only men like ourselves; and (Allah) Most Gracious sends no sort of revelation: ye do nothing but lie."
15.shakir: They said: You are naught but mortals like ourselves, nor has the Beneficent Allah revealed anything; you only lie.
15.muhammad_sarwar: The people said, "You are mere mortals like us and the Beneficent God has sent nothing. You are only liars."
15.mohsin_khan: They (people of the town) said: "You are only human beings like ourselves, and the Most Beneficent (Allah) has revealed nothing, you are only telling lies."
15.arberry: They said, 'You are naught but mortals like us; the All-merciful has not sent down anything. You are speaking only lies.'

16.sahih_international: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,
16.pickthall: They answered: Our Lord knoweth that we are indeed sent unto you,
16.yusuf_ali: They said: "Our Lord doth know that we have been sent on a mission to you:
16.shakir: They said: Our Lord knows that we are most surely apostles to you.
16.muhammad_sarwar: They said, "Our Lord knows that We are Messengers
16.mohsin_khan: The Messengers said: "Our Lord knows that we have been sent as Messengers to you,
16.arberry: They said, 'Our Lord knows we are Envoys unto you;

17.sahih_international: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."
17.pickthall: And our duty is but plain conveyance (of the message).
17.yusuf_ali: "And our duty is only to proclaim the clear Message."
17.shakir: And nothing devolves on us but a clear deliverance (of the message).
17.muhammad_sarwar: who have been sent to you. Our only duty is to preach clearly to you".
17.mohsin_khan: "And our duty is only to convey plainly (the Message)."
17.arberry: and it is only for us to deliver the Manifest Message.'

18.sahih_international: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."
18.pickthall: (The people of the city) said: We augur ill of you. If ye desist not, we shall surely stone you, and grievous torture will befall you at our hands.
18.yusuf_ali: The (people) said: "for us, we augur an evil omen from you: if ye desist not, we will certainly stone you. And a grievous punishment indeed will be inflicted on you by us."
18.shakir: They said: Surely we augur evil from you; if you do not desist, we will certainly stone you, and there shall certainly afflict you a painful chastisement from us.
18.muhammad_sarwar: The people said, "We have ill omens about you. If you will not desist, we shall stone you and make you suffer a painful torment".
18.mohsin_khan: They (people) said: "For us, we see an evil omen from you, if you cease not, we will surely stone you, and a painful torment will touch you from us."
18.arberry: They said, 'We augur ill of you. If you give not over, we will stone you and there shall visit you from us a painful chastisement.'

19.sahih_international: They said, "Your omen is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."
19.pickthall: They said: Your evil augury be with you! Is it because ye are reminded (of the truth)? Nay, but ye are froward folk!
19.yusuf_ali: They said: "Your evil omens are with yourselves: (deem ye this an evil omen). If ye are admonished? Nay, but ye are a people transgressing all bounds!"
19.shakir: They said: Your evil fortune is with you; what! if you are reminded! Nay, you are an extravagant people.
19.muhammad_sarwar: The Messengers said, "This ill omen lies within yourselves. Will you then take heed? In fact, you are a transgressing people."
19.mohsin_khan: They (Messengers) said: "Your evil omens be with you! (Do you call it "evil omen") because you are admonished? Nay, but you are a people Musrifun (transgressing all bounds by committing all kinds of great sins, and by disobeying Allah).
19.arberry: They said, 'Your augury is with you; if you are reminded? But you are a prodigal people.'

20.sahih_international: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.
20.pickthall: And there came from the uttermost part of the city a man running. He cried: O my people! Follow those who have been sent!
20.yusuf_ali: Then there came running, from the farthest part of the City, a man, saying, "O my people! Obey the messengers:
20.shakir: And from the remote part of the city there came a man running, he said: O my people! follow the apostles;
20.muhammad_sarwar: A man came running from the farthest part of the city saying, "My people, follow the Messengers.
20.mohsin_khan: And there came running from the farthest part of the town, a man, saying: "O my people! Obey the Messengers;
20.arberry: Then came a man from the furthest part of the city, running; he said, 'My people, follow the Envoys!

21.sahih_international: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.
21.pickthall: Follow those who ask of you no fee, and who are rightly guided.
21.yusuf_ali: "Obey those who ask no reward of you (for themselves), and who have themselves received Guidance.
21.shakir: Follow him who does not ask you for reward, and they are the followers of the right course;
21.muhammad_sarwar: Follow those who do not ask you for any reward and who are rightly guided.
21.mohsin_khan: "Obey those who ask no wages of you (for themselves), and who are rightly guided.
21.arberry: Follow such as ask no wage of you, that are right-guided.

22.sahih_international: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?
22.pickthall: For what cause should I not serve Him Who hath created me, and unto Whom ye will be brought back?
22.yusuf_ali: "It would not be reasonable in me if I did not serve Him Who created me, and to Whom ye shall (all) be brought back.
22.shakir: And what reason have I that I should not serve Him Who brought me into existence? And to Him you shall be brought back;
22.muhammad_sarwar: "Why should I not worship God who has created me? To him you will all return.
22.mohsin_khan: "And why should I not worship Him (Allah Alone) Who has created me and to Whom you shall be returned.
22.arberry: And why should I not serve Him who originated me, and unto whom you shall be returned?

23.sahih_international: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?
23.pickthall: Shall I take (other) gods in place of Him when, if the Beneficent should wish me any harm, their intercession will avail me naught, nor can they save?
23.yusuf_ali: "Shall I take (other) gods besides Him? If (Allah) Most Gracious should intend some adversity for me, of no use whatever will be their intercession for me, nor can they deliver me.
23.shakir: What! shall I take besides Him gods whose intercession, If the Beneficent Allah should desire to afflict me with a harm, shall not avail me aught, nor shall they be able to deliver me?
23.muhammad_sarwar: Should I worship other gods besides Him? If the Beneficent God was to afflict me with hardship, the intercession of the idols can be of no benefit to me nor could it rescue me from hardship.
23.mohsin_khan: "Shall I take besides Him aliha (gods), if the Most Beneficent (Allah) intends me any harm, their intercession will be of no use for me whatsoever, nor can they save me?
23.arberry: What, shall I take, apart from Him, gods whose intercession, if the All-merciful desires affliction for me, shall not avail me anything, and who will never deliver me?

24.sahih_international: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.
24.pickthall: Then truly I should be in error manifest.
24.yusuf_ali: "I would indeed, if I were to do so, be in manifest Error.
24.shakir: In that case I shall most surely be in clear error:
24.muhammad_sarwar: (Had I worshipped things besides God, I would have been in manifest error).
24.mohsin_khan: "Then verily, I should be in plain error.
24.arberry: Surely in that case I should be in manifest error.

25.sahih_international: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."
25.pickthall: Lo! I have believed in your Lord, so hear me!
25.yusuf_ali: "For me, I have faith in the Lord of you (all): listen, then, to me!"
25.shakir: Surely I believe in your Lord, therefore hear me.
25.muhammad_sarwar: Messengers, listen to me. I believe in your Lord."
25.mohsin_khan: Verily! I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me!"
25.arberry: Behold, I believe in your Lord; therefore hear me!'

26.sahih_international: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know
26.pickthall: It was said (unto him): Enter paradise. He said: Would that my people knew
26.yusuf_ali: It was said: "Enter thou the Garden." He said: "Ah me! Would that my People knew (what I know)!-
26.shakir: It was said: Enter the garden. He said: O would that my people had known
26.muhammad_sarwar: (Having been murdered by the disbelievers) he was told to enter paradise
26.mohsin_khan: It was said (to him when the disbelievers killed him): "Enter Paradise." He said: "Would that my people knew!
26.arberry: It was said, 'Enter Paradise!' He said, 'Ah, would that my people had knowledge

27.sahih_international: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."
27.pickthall: With what (munificence) my Lord hath pardoned me and made me of the honoured ones!
27.yusuf_ali: "For that my Lord has granted me Forgiveness and has enrolled me among those held in honour!"
27.shakir: Of that on account of which my Lord has forgiven me and made me of the honored ones!
27.muhammad_sarwar: (wherein he said), "Would that people knew how my Lord has granted me forgiveness and honor".
27.mohsin_khan: "That my Lord (Allah) has forgiven me, and made me of the honoured ones!"
27.arberry: that my Lord has forgiven me and that He has placed me among the honoured.'

28.sahih_international: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.
28.pickthall: We sent not down against his people after him a host from heaven, nor do We ever send.
28.yusuf_ali: And We sent not down against his People, after him, any hosts from heaven, nor was it needful for Us so to do.
28.shakir: And We did not send down upon his people after him any hosts from heaven, nor do We ever send down.
28.muhammad_sarwar: We did not send an army against his people from the heaven after his death nor did We need to send one.
28.mohsin_khan: And We sent not against his people after him a host from heaven, nor do We send (such a thing).
28.arberry: And We sent not down upon his people, after him, any host out of heaven; neither would We send any down.

29.sahih_international: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished.
29.pickthall: It was but one Shout, and lo! they were extinct.
29.yusuf_ali: It was no more than a single mighty Blast, and behold! they were (like ashes) quenched and silent.
29.shakir: It was naught but a single cry, and lo! they were still.
29.muhammad_sarwar: It was only a single blast which made them extinct.
29.mohsin_khan: It was but one Saihah (shout, etc.) and lo! They (all) were silent (dead-destroyed).
29.arberry: It was only one Cry and lo, they were silent and still.

30.sahih_international: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.
30.pickthall: Ah, the anguish for the bondmen! Never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him!
30.yusuf_ali: Ah! Alas for (My) Servants! There comes not a messenger to them but they mock him!
30.shakir: Alas for the servants! there comes not to them an apostle but they mock at him.
30.muhammad_sarwar: Woe to human beings! Whenever a Messenger came to them, they mocked him.
30.mohsin_khan: Alas for mankind! There never came a Messenger to them but they used to mock at him.
30.arberry: Ah, woe for those servants! Never comes unto them a Messenger, but they mock at him.

31.sahih_international: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return?
31.pickthall: Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them, which indeed returned not unto them;
31.yusuf_ali: See they not how many generations before them we destroyed? Not to them will they return:
31.shakir: Do they not consider how many of the generations have We destroyed before them, because they do not turn to them?
31.muhammad_sarwar: Have they not seen how many generations, living before them, had We destroyed and they cannot ever come back to them?
31.mohsin_khan: Do they not see how many of the generations We have destroyed before them? Verily, they will not return to them.
31.arberry: What, have they not seen how many generations We have destroyed before them, and that it is not unto them that they return?

32.sahih_international: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.
32.pickthall: But all, without exception, will be brought before Us.
32.yusuf_ali: But each one of them all - will be brought before Us (for judgment).
32.shakir: And all of them shall surely be brought before Us.
32.muhammad_sarwar: They will all be brought into Our presence together.
32.mohsin_khan: And surely, all, everyone of them will be brought before Us.
32.arberry: They shall every one of them be arraigned before Us.

33.sahih_international: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.
33.pickthall: A token unto them is the dead earth. We revive it, and We bring forth from it grain so that they eat thereof;
33.yusuf_ali: A Sign for them is the earth that is dead: We do give it life, and produce grain therefrom, of which ye do eat.
33.shakir: And a sign to them is the dead earth: We give life to it and bring forth from it grain SQ they eat of it.
33.muhammad_sarwar: Evidence (of the truth) for them is how We revived the dead earth
33.mohsin_khan: And a sign for them is the dead land. We gave it life, and We brought forth from it grains, so that they eat thereof.
33.arberry: And a sign for them is the dead land, that We quickened and brought forth from it grain, whereof they eat;

34.sahih_international: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -
34.pickthall: And We have placed therein gardens of the date-palm and grapes, and We have caused springs of water to gush forth therein,
34.yusuf_ali: And We produce therein orchard with date-palms and vines, and We cause springs to gush forth therein:
34.shakir: And We make therein gardens of palms and grapevines and We make springs to flow forth in it,
34.muhammad_sarwar: and produced therein grains from which they eat and established therein gardens of palms trees and vineyards and have made streams flow therein
34.mohsin_khan: And We have made therein gardens of date-palms and grapes, and We have caused springs of water to gush forth therein.
34.arberry: and We made therein gardens of palms and vines, and therein We caused fountains to gush forth,

35.sahih_international: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful?
35.pickthall: That they may eat of the fruit thereof, and their hands made it not. Will they not, then, give thanks?
35.yusuf_ali: That they may enjoy the fruits of this (artistry): It was not their hands that made this: will they not then give thanks?
35.shakir: That they may eat of the fruit thereof, and their hands did not make it; will they not then be grateful?
35.muhammad_sarwar: so that they may consume the fruits and whatever their hands prepare. Will they not then be grateful?
35.mohsin_khan: So that they may eat of the fruit thereof, and their hands made it not. Will they not, then, give thanks?
35.arberry: that they might eat of its fruits and their hands' labour. What, will they not be thankful?

36.sahih_international: Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.
36.pickthall: Glory be to Him Who created all the sexual pairs, of that which the earth groweth, and of themselves, and of that which they know not!
36.yusuf_ali: Glory to Allah, Who created in pairs all things that the earth produces, as well as their own (human) kind and (other) things of which they have no knowledge.
36.shakir: Glory be to Him Who created pairs of all things, of what the earth grows, and of their kind and of what they do not know.
36.muhammad_sarwar: All glory belongs to the One Who has created pairs out of what grow from the earth, out of their soul and out of that which they do not know.
36.mohsin_khan: Glory be to Him, Who has created all the pairs of that which the earth produces, as well as of their own (human) kind (male and female), and of that which they know not.
36.arberry: Glory be to Him, who created all the pairs of what the earth produces, and of themselves, and of what they know not.

37.sahih_international: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it [the light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.
37.pickthall: A token unto them is night. We strip it of the day, and lo! they are in darkness.
37.yusuf_ali: And a Sign for them is the Night: We withdraw therefrom the Day, and behold they are plunged in darkness;
37.shakir: And a sign to them is the night: We draw forth from it the day, then lo! they are in the dark;
37.muhammad_sarwar: Of the signs for them is how We separated the day from the night and thus they remained in darkness;
37.mohsin_khan: And a sign for them is the night, We withdraw therefrom the day, and behold, they are in darkness.
37.arberry: And a sign for them is the night; We strip it of the day and lo, they are in darkness.

38.sahih_international: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
38.pickthall: And the sun runneth on unto a resting-place for him. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Wise.
38.yusuf_ali: And the sun runs his course for a period determined for him: that is the decree of (Him), the Exalted in Might, the All-Knowing.
38.shakir: And the sun runs on to a term appointed for it; that is the ordinance of the Mighty, the Knowing.
38.muhammad_sarwar: how the sun moves in its orbit and this is the decree of the Majestic and All-knowing God;
38.mohsin_khan: And the sun runs on its fixed course for a term (appointed). That is the Decree of the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.
38.arberry: And the sun -- it runs to a fixed resting-place; that is the ordaining of the All-mighty, the All-knowing.

39.sahih_international: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.
39.pickthall: And for the moon We have appointed mansions till she return like an old shrivelled palm-leaf.
39.yusuf_ali: And the Moon,- We have measured for her mansions (to traverse) till she returns like the old (and withered) lower part of a date-stalk.
39.shakir: And (as for) the moon, We have ordained for it stages till it becomes again as an old dry palm branch.
39.muhammad_sarwar: how We ordained the moon to pass through certain phases until it seems eventually to be like a bent twig;
39.mohsin_khan: And the moon, We have measured for it mansions (to traverse) till it returns like the old dried curved date stalk.
39.arberry: And the moon -- We have determined it by stations, till it returns like an aged palm-bough.

40.sahih_international: It is not allowable for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.
40.pickthall: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor doth the night outstrip the day. They float each in an orbit.
40.yusuf_ali: It is not permitted to the Sun to catch up the Moon, nor can the Night outstrip the Day: Each (just) swims along in (its own) orbit (according to Law).
40.shakir: Neither is it allowable to the sun that it should overtake the moon, nor can the night outstrip the day; and all float on in a sphere.
40.muhammad_sarwar: how the sun is not supposed to catch-up with the moon, nor is the night to precede the day. All of them are to float in a certain orbit;
40.mohsin_khan: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor does the night outstrip the day. They all float, each in an orbit.
40.arberry: It behoves not the sun to overtake the moon, neither does the night outstrip the day, each swimming in a sky.

41.sahih_international: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship.
41.pickthall: And a token unto them is that We bear their offspring in the laden ship,
41.yusuf_ali: And a Sign for them is that We bore their race (through the Flood) in the loaded Ark;
41.shakir: And a sign to them is that We bear their offspring in the laden ship.
41.muhammad_sarwar: how We carried them and their offspring inside the laden Ark
41.mohsin_khan: And an Ayah (sign) for them is that We bore their offspring in the laden ship [of Nuh (Noah)].
41.arberry: And a sign for them is that We carried their seed in the laden ship,

42.sahih_international: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.
42.pickthall: And have created for them of the like thereof whereon they ride.
42.yusuf_ali: And We have created for them similar (vessels) on which they ride.
42.shakir: And We have created for them the like of it, what they will ride on.
42.muhammad_sarwar: and created for them similar things to ride.
42.mohsin_khan: And We have created for them of the like thereunto, so on them they ride.
42.arberry: and We have created for them the like of it whereon they ride;

43.sahih_international: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved
43.pickthall: And if We will, We drown them, and there is no help for them, neither can they be saved;
43.yusuf_ali: If it were Our Will, We could drown them: then would there be no helper (to hear their cry), nor could they be delivered,
43.shakir: And if We please, We can drown them, then there shall be no succorer for them, nor shall they be rescued
43.muhammad_sarwar: Had We wanted, We could have drowned them and nothing would have been able to help or rescue them
43.mohsin_khan: And if We will, We shall drown them, and there will be no shout (or helper) for them (to hear their cry for help) nor will they be saved.
43.arberry: and if We will, We drown them, then none have they to cry to, neither are they delivered,

44.sahih_international: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.
44.pickthall: Unless by mercy from Us and as comfort for a while.
44.yusuf_ali: Except by way of Mercy from Us, and by way of (world) convenience (to serve them) for a time.
44.shakir: But (by) mercy from Us and for enjoyment till a time.
44.muhammad_sarwar: except Our mercy which could enable them to enjoy themselves for an appointed time.
44.mohsin_khan: Unless it be a mercy from Us, and as an enjoyment for a while.
44.arberry: save as a mercy from Us, and enjoyment for a while.

45.sahih_international: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy... "
45.pickthall: When it is said unto them: Beware of that which is before you and that which is behind you, that haply ye may find mercy (they are heedless).
45.yusuf_ali: When they are told, "Fear ye that which is before you and that which will be after you, in order that ye may receive Mercy," (they turn back).
45.shakir: And when it is said to them: Guard against what is before you and what is behind you, that mercy may be had on you.
45.muhammad_sarwar: Whenever they are told to guard themselves against sin and the forth coming torment so that perhaps they could receive mercy
45.mohsin_khan: And when it is said to them: "Beware of that which is before you (worldly torments), and that which is behind you (torments in the Hereafter), in order that you may receive Mercy (i.e. if you believe in Allah's Religion Islamic Monotheism, and avoid polytheism, and obey Allah with righteous deeds).
45.arberry: And when it is said to them, 'Fear what is before you and what is behind you; haply you will find mercy' --

46.sahih_international: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.
46.pickthall: Never came a token of the tokens of their Lord to them, but they did turn away from it!
46.yusuf_ali: Not a Sign comes to them from among the Signs of their Lord, but they turn away therefrom.
46.shakir: And there comes not to them a communication of the communications of their Lord but they turn aside from it.
46.muhammad_sarwar: and whenever a revelation out of their Lord's revelations comes to them, they ignore it.
46.mohsin_khan: And never came an Ayah from among the Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of their Lord to them, but they did turn away from it.
46.arberry: yet never any sign of the signs of their Lord comes to them, but they are turning away from it.

47.sahih_international: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."
47.pickthall: And when it is said unto them: Spend of that wherewith Allah hath provided you, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Shall we feed those whom Allah, if He willed, would feed? Ye are in naught else than error manifest.
47.yusuf_ali: And when they are told, "Spend ye of (the bounties) with which Allah has provided you," the Unbelievers say to those who believe: "Shall we then feed those whom, if Allah had so willed, He would have fed, (Himself)?- Ye are in nothing but manifest error."
47.shakir: And when it is said to them: Spend out of what Allah has given you, those who disbelieve say to those who believe: Shall we feed him whom, if Allah please, He could feed? You are in naught but clear error.
47.muhammad_sarwar: When they are told to spend for the cause of God out of what He has provided for them for their sustenance, the disbelievers say to the believers, "Should we feed those whom God has decided to feed? You are in plain error."
47.mohsin_khan: And when it is said to them: "Spend of that with which Allah has provided you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe: "Shall we feed those whom, if Allah willed, He (Himself) would have fed? You are only in a plain error."
47.arberry: And when it is said to them, 'Expend of that God has provided you,' the unbelievers say to the believers, 'What, shall we feed such a one whom, if God willed, He would feed? You are only in manifest error!'

48.sahih_international: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
48.pickthall: And they say: When will this promise be fulfilled, if ye are truthful?
48.yusuf_ali: Further, they say, "When will this promise (come to pass), if what ye say is true?"
48.shakir: And they say: When will this threat come to pass, if you are truthful?
48.muhammad_sarwar: The unbelievers say, "When will the Day of Judgment come if what you say is at all true?"
48.mohsin_khan: And they say: "When will this promise (i.e. Resurrection) be fulfilled, if you are truthful?"
48.arberry: They also say, 'When shall this promise come to pass, if you speak truly?'

49.sahih_international: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing.
49.pickthall: They await but one Shout, which will surprise them while they are disputing.
49.yusuf_ali: They will not (have to) wait for aught but a single Blast: it will seize them while they are yet disputing among themselves!
49.shakir: They wait not for aught but a single cry which will overtake them while they yet contend with one another.
49.muhammad_sarwar: They will not have to wait long. When the Day of Judgment comes, it will only take a single blast of sound to strike them while they are quarrelling with one another.
49.mohsin_khan: They await only but a single Saihah (shout, etc.), which will seize them while they are disputing!
49.arberry: They are awaiting only for one Cry to seize them while they are yet disputing,

50.sahih_international: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.
50.pickthall: Then they cannot make bequest, nor can they return to their own folk.
50.yusuf_ali: No (chance) will they then have, by will, to dispose (of their affairs), nor to return to their own people!
50.shakir: So they shall not be able to make a bequest, nor shall they return to their families.
50.muhammad_sarwar: Then they will not be able to make a will or return to their families.
50.mohsin_khan: Then they will not be able to make bequest, nor they will return to their family.
50.arberry: then they will not be able to make any testament, nor will they return to their people.

51.sahih_international: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.
51.pickthall: And the trumpet is blown and lo! from the graves they hie unto their Lord,
51.yusuf_ali: The trumpet shall be sounded, when behold! from the sepulchres (men) will rush forth to their Lord!
51.shakir: And the trumpet shall be blown, when lo! from their graves they shall hasten on to their Lord.
51.muhammad_sarwar: When the trumpet is sounded, they will be driven out of their grave into the presence of their Lord.
51.mohsin_khan: And the Trumpet will be blown (i.e. the second blowing) and behold! From the graves they will come out quickly to their Lord.
51.arberry: And the Trumpet shall be blown; then behold, they are sliding down from their tombs unto their Lord.

52.sahih_international: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."
52.pickthall: Crying: Woe upon us! Who hath raised us from our place of sleep? This is that which the Beneficent did promise, and the messengers spoke truth.
52.yusuf_ali: They will say: "Ah! Woe unto us! Who hath raised us up from our beds of repose?"... (A voice will say:) "This is what (Allah) Most Gracious had promised. And true was the word of the messengers!"
52.shakir: They shall say: O woe to us! who has raised us up from our sleeping-place? This is what the Beneficent Allah promised and the apostles told the truth.
52.muhammad_sarwar: They will say, "Woe to us! Who has raised us up from our graves? This is what the Beneficent God has promised. The Messengers have also spoke the truth".
52.mohsin_khan: They will say: "Woe to us! Who has raised us up from our place of sleep." (It will be said to them): "This is what the Most Beneficent (Allah) had promised, and the Messengers spoke truth!"
52.arberry: They say, 'Alas for us! Who roused us out of our sleeping place? This is what the All-merciful promised, and the Envoys spoke truly.'

53.sahih_international: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.
53.pickthall: It is but one Shout, and behold them brought together before Us!
53.yusuf_ali: It will be no more than a single Blast, when lo! they will all be brought up before Us!
53.shakir: There would be naught but a single cry, when lo! they shall all be brought before Us;
53.muhammad_sarwar: Only after a single blast of sound, they will all be brought into Our presence.
53.mohsin_khan: It will be but a single Saihah (shout, etc.), so behold! They will all be brought up before Us!
53.arberry: 'It was only one Cry; then behold, they are all arraigned before Us.

54.sahih_international: So today no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.
54.pickthall: This day no soul is wronged in aught; nor are ye requited aught save what ye used to do.
54.yusuf_ali: Then, on that Day, not a soul will be wronged in the least, and ye shall but be repaid the meeds of your past Deeds.
54.shakir: So this day no soul shall be dealt with unjustly in the least; and you shall not be rewarded aught but that which you did.
54.muhammad_sarwar: No soul will be in the least bit wronged on that Day and no one will receive any recompense other than what he deserves for his deeds.
54.mohsin_khan: This Day (Day of Resurrection), none will be wronged in anything, nor will you be requited anything except that which you used to do.
54.arberry: So today no soul shall be wronged anything, and you shall not be recompensed, except according to what you have been doing.

55.sahih_international: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -
55.pickthall: Lo! those who merit paradise this day are happily employed,
55.yusuf_ali: Verily the Companions of the Garden shall that Day have joy in all that they do;
55.shakir: Surely the dwellers of the garden shall on that day be in an occupation quite happy.
55.muhammad_sarwar: The dwellers of Paradise on that day will enjoy themselves.
55.mohsin_khan: Verily, the dwellers of the Paradise, that Day, will be busy in joyful things.
55.arberry: See, the inhabitants of Paradise today are busy in their rejoicing,

56.sahih_international: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.
56.pickthall: They and their wives, in pleasant shade, on thrones reclining;
56.yusuf_ali: They and their associates will be in groves of (cool) shade, reclining on Thrones (of dignity);
56.shakir: They and their wives shall be in shades, reclining on raised couches.
56.muhammad_sarwar: They and their spouses will recline on couches in the shade therein.
56.mohsin_khan: They and their wives will be in pleasant shade, reclining on thrones.
56.arberry: they and their spouses, reclining upon couches in the shade;

57.sahih_international: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]
57.pickthall: Theirs the fruit (of their good deeds) and theirs (all) that they ask;
57.yusuf_ali: (Every) fruit (enjoyment) will be there for them; they shall have whatever they call for;
57.shakir: They shall have fruits therein, and they shall have whatever they desire.
57.muhammad_sarwar: They will have fruits and whatever they desire.
57.mohsin_khan: They will have therein fruits (of all kinds) and all that they ask for.
57.arberry: therein they have fruits, and they have all that they call for.

58.sahih_international: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.
58.pickthall: The word from a Merciful Lord (for them) is: Peace!
58.yusuf_ali: "Peace!" - a word (of salutation) from a Lord Most Merciful!
58.shakir: Peace: a word from a Merciful Lord.
58.muhammad_sarwar: "Peace be with you," will be a greeting for them from the Merciful Lord.
58.mohsin_khan: (It will be said to them): Salamun (peace be on you), a Word from the Lord (Allah), Most Merciful.
58.arberry: 'Peace!' -- such is the greeting, from a Lord All-compassionate.

59.sahih_international: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.
59.pickthall: But avaunt ye, O ye guilty, this day!
59.yusuf_ali: "And O ye in sin! Get ye apart this Day!
59.shakir: And get aside today, O guilty ones!
59.muhammad_sarwar: (The Lord will command), "Criminals, stand away from the others on this day."
59.mohsin_khan: (It will be said): "And O you Al-Mujrimun (criminals, polytheists, sinners, disbelievers in the Islamic Monotheism, wicked evil ones, etc.)! Get you apart this Day (from the believers).
59.arberry: 'Now keep yourselves apart, you sinners, upon this day!

60.sahih_international: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -
60.pickthall: Did I not charge you, O ye sons of Adam, that ye worship not the devil - Lo! he is your open foe! -
60.yusuf_ali: "Did I not enjoin on you, O ye Children of Adam, that ye should not worship Satan; for that he was to you an enemy avowed?-
60.shakir: Did I not charge you, O children of Adam! that you should not serve the Shaitan? Surely he is your open enemy,
60.muhammad_sarwar: Children of Adam, did We not command you not to worship satan. He was your sworn enemy.
60.mohsin_khan: Did I not ordain for you, O Children of Adam, that you should not worship Shaitan (Satan). Verily, he is a plain enemy to you.
60.arberry: Made I not covenant with you, Children of Adam, that you should not serve Satan -- surely he is a manifest foe to you --

61.sahih_international: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.
61.pickthall: But that ye worship Me? That was the right path.
61.yusuf_ali: "And that ye should worship Me, (for that) this was the Straight Way?
61.shakir: And that you should serve Me; this is the right way.
61.muhammad_sarwar: Did We not command you to worship Me and tell you that this is the straight path?"
61.mohsin_khan: And that you should worship Me [Alone Islamic Monotheism, and set up not rivals, associate-gods with Me]. That is a Straight Path.
61.arberry: and that you should serve Me? This is a straight path.

62.sahih_international: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?
62.pickthall: Yet he hath led astray of you a great multitude. Had ye then no sense?
62.yusuf_ali: "But he did lead astray a great multitude of you. Did ye not, then, understand?
62.shakir: And certainly he led astray numerous people from among you. What! could you not then understand?
62.muhammad_sarwar: Satan misled a great multitude of you. Did you not have any understanding?
62.mohsin_khan: And indeed he (Satan) did lead astray a great multitude of you. Did you not, then, understand?
62.arberry: He led astray many a throng of you; did you not understand?

63.sahih_international: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.
63.pickthall: This is hell which ye were promised (if ye followed him).
63.yusuf_ali: "This is the Hell of which ye were (repeatedly) warned!
63.shakir: This is the hell with which you were threatened.
63.muhammad_sarwar: This is hell with which you were threatened.
63.mohsin_khan: This is Hell which you were promised!
63.arberry: This is Gehenna, then, the same that you were promised;

64.sahih_international: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."
64.pickthall: Burn therein this day for that ye disbelieved.
64.yusuf_ali: "Embrace ye the (fire) this Day, for that ye (persistently) rejected (Truth)."
64.shakir: Enter into it this day because you disbelieved.
64.muhammad_sarwar: Suffer therein on this day for your disbelief.
64.mohsin_khan: Burn therein this Day, for that you used to disbelieve.
64.arberry: roast well in it today, for that you were unbelievers!'

65.sahih_international: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.
65.pickthall: This day We seal up their mouths, and their hands speak out to Us and their feet bear witness as to what they used to earn.
65.yusuf_ali: That Day shall We set a seal on their mouths. But their hands will speak to us, and their feet bear witness, to all that they did.
65.shakir: On that day We will set a seal upon their mouths, and their hands shall speak to Us, and their feet shall bear witness of what they earned.
65.muhammad_sarwar: We shall seal your mouths on that Day, let your hands speak to us and your feet testify to what you had achieved.
65.mohsin_khan: This Day, We shall seal up their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their legs will bear witness to what they used to earn. (It is said that one's left thigh will be the first to bear the witness). [Tafsir At-Tabari, Vol. 22, Page 24]
65.arberry: Today We set a seal on their mouths, and their hands speak to Us, and their feet bear witness as to what they have been earning.

66.sahih_international: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?
66.pickthall: And had We willed, We verily could have quenched their eyesight so that they should struggle for the way. Then how could they have seen?
66.yusuf_ali: If it had been our Will, We could surely have blotted out their eyes; then should they have run about groping for the Path, but how could they have seen?
66.shakir: And if We please We would certainly put out their eyes, then they would run about groping for the way, but how should they see?
66.muhammad_sarwar: We could have blinded them had We wanted. Then they would have raced along to cross the Bridge but how could they have seen (their way)?
66.mohsin_khan: And if it had been Our Will, We would surely have wiped out (blinded) their eyes, so that they would struggle for the Path, how then would they see?
66.arberry: Did We will, We would have obliterated their eyes, then they would race to the path, but how would they see?

67.sahih_international: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.
67.pickthall: And had We willed, We verily could have fixed them in their place, making them powerless to go forward or turn back.
67.yusuf_ali: And if it had been Our Will, We could have transformed them (to remain) in their places; then should they have been unable to move about, nor could they have returned (after error).
67.shakir: And if We please We would surely transform them in their place, then they would not be able to go on, nor will they return.
67.muhammad_sarwar: We could have turned them into other creatures on the spot had We wanted and they would not have been able to precede or turn back.
67.mohsin_khan: And if it had been Our Will, We could have transformed them (into animals or lifeless objects) in their places. Then they should have been unable to go forward (move about) nor they could have turned back. [As it happened with the Jews see Verse 7:166 The Quran].
67.arberry: Did We will, We would have changed them where they were, then they could not go on, nor could they return.

68.sahih_international: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand?
68.pickthall: He whom we bring unto old age, We reverse him in creation (making him go back to weakness after strength). Have ye then no sense?
68.yusuf_ali: If We grant long life to any, We cause him to be reversed in nature: Will they not then understand?
68.shakir: And whomsoever We cause to live long, We reduce (him) to an abject state in constitution; do they not then understand?
68.muhammad_sarwar: The physical growth of those whom We grant a long life will be reversed. Will you then not understand?
68.mohsin_khan: And he whom We grant long life, We reverse him in creation (weakness after strength). Will they not then understand?
68.arberry: And to whomsoever We give long life, We bend him over in His constitution; what, do they not understand?

69.sahih_international: And We did not give Prophet Muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur'an
69.pickthall: And We have not taught him (Muhammad) poetry, nor is it meet for him. This is naught else than a Reminder and a Lecture making plain,
69.yusuf_ali: We have not instructed the (Prophet) in Poetry, nor is it meet for him: this is no less than a Message and a Qur'an making things clear:
69.shakir: And We have not taught him poetry, nor is it meet for him; it is nothing but a reminder and a plain Quran,
69.muhammad_sarwar: We did not teach him (Muhammad) poetry, nor was he supposed to be a poet. It is only the word (of God) and the illustrious Quran
69.mohsin_khan: And We have not taught him (Muhammad SAW) poetry, nor is it meet for him. This is only a Reminder and a plain Quran.
69.arberry: We have not taught him poetry; it is not seemly for him. It is only a Remembrance and a Clear Koran,

70.sahih_international: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers.
70.pickthall: To warn whosoever liveth, and that the word may be fulfilled against the disbelievers.
70.yusuf_ali: That it may give admonition to any (who are) alive, and that the charge may be proved against those who reject (Truth).
70.shakir: That it may warn him who would have life, and (that) the word may prove true against the unbelievers.
70.muhammad_sarwar: by which he may warn those who are living and may let the words of God come true against the unbelievers.
70.mohsin_khan: That he or it (Muhammad SAW or the Quran) may give warning to him who is living (a healthy minded the believer), and that Word (charge) may be justified against the disbelievers (dead, as they reject the warnings).
70.arberry: that he may warn whosoever is living, and that the Word may be realized against the unbelievers.

71.sahih_international: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?
71.pickthall: Have they not seen how We have created for them of Our handiwork the cattle, so that they are their owners,
71.yusuf_ali: See they not that it is We Who have created for them - among the things which Our hands have fashioned - cattle, which are under their dominion?-
71.shakir: Do they not see that We have created cattle for them, out of what Our hands have wrought, so they are their masters?
71.muhammad_sarwar: Have they not seen what We have created from the labor of Our own hands? We have given them cattle.
71.mohsin_khan: Do they not see that We have created for them of what Our Hands have created, the cattle, so that they are their owners.
71.arberry: Have they not seen how that We have created for them of that Our hands wrought cattle that they own?

72.sahih_international: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.
72.pickthall: And have subdued them unto them, so that some of them they have for riding, some for food?
72.yusuf_ali: And that We have subjected them to their (use)? of them some do carry them and some they eat:
72.shakir: And We have subjected them to them, so some of them they have to ride upon, and some of them they eat.
72.muhammad_sarwar: We have made the cattle subservient to them so they ride and consume them.
72.mohsin_khan: And We have subdued them unto them so that some of them they have for riding and some they eat.
72.arberry: We have subdued them to them, and some of them they ride, and some they eat;

73.sahih_international: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?
73.pickthall: Benefits and (divers) drinks have they from them. Will they not then give thanks?
73.yusuf_ali: And they have (other) profits from them (besides), and they get (milk) to drink. Will they not then be grateful?
73.shakir: And therein they have advantages and drinks; will they not then be grateful?
73.muhammad_sarwar: From cattle they get milk and other benefits. Will they not then give thanks?
73.mohsin_khan: And they have (other) benefits from them (besides), and they get (milk) to drink, will they not then be grateful?
73.arberry: other uses also they have in them, and beverages. What, will they not be thankful?

74.sahih_international: But they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.
74.pickthall: And they have taken (other) gods beside Allah, in order that they may be helped.
74.yusuf_ali: Yet they take (for worship) gods other than Allah, (hoping) that they might be helped!
74.shakir: And they have taken gods besides Allah that they may be helped.
74.muhammad_sarwar: They chose idols besides God in the hope of receiving help from them, but they will not be able to help them.
74.mohsin_khan: And they have taken besides Allah aliha (gods), hoping that they might be helped (by those so called gods).
74.arberry: Yet they have taken, apart from God, gods; haply they might be helped.

75.sahih_international: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.
75.pickthall: It is not in their power to help them; but they (the worshippers) are unto them a host in arms.
75.yusuf_ali: They have not the power to help them: but they will be brought up (before Our Judgment-seat) as a troop (to be condemned).
75.shakir: (But) they shall not be able to assist them, and they shall be a host brought up before them.
75.muhammad_sarwar: Instead, the disbelievers will be brought into the presence of God as the soldiers of the idols.
75.mohsin_khan: They cannot help them, but they will be brought forward as a troop against those who worshipped them (at the time of Reckoning).
75.arberry: They cannot help them, though they be hosts made ready for them.

76.sahih_international: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.
76.pickthall: So let not their speech grieve thee (O Muhammad). Lo! We know what they conceal and what proclaim.
76.yusuf_ali: Let not their speech, then, grieve thee. Verily We know what they hide as well as what they disclose.
76.shakir: Therefore let not their speech grieve you; surely We know what they do in secret and what they do openly.
76.muhammad_sarwar: Muhammad, let not their words annoy you. We certainly know whatever they conceal or reveal.
76.mohsin_khan: So let not their speech, then, grieve you (O Muhammad SAW). Verily, We know what they conceal and what they reveal.
76.arberry: So do not let their saying grieve thee; assuredly We know what they keep secret and what they publish.

77.sahih_international: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?
77.pickthall: Hath not man seen that We have created him from a drop of seed? Yet lo! he is an open opponent.
77.yusuf_ali: Doth not man see that it is We Who created him from sperm? yet behold! he (stands forth) as an open adversary!
77.shakir: Does not man see that We have created him from the small seed? Then lo! he is an open disputant.
77.muhammad_sarwar: Has the human being not considered that We have created him from a drop of fluid. He is openly quarrelsome.
77.mohsin_khan: Does not man see that We have created him from Nutfah (mixed male and female discharge semen drops). Yet behold! He (stands forth) as an open opponent.
77.arberry: Has not man regarded how that We created him of a sperm-drop? Then lo, he is a manifest adversary.

78.sahih_international: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"
78.pickthall: And he hath coined for Us a similitude, and hath forgotten the fact of his creation, saying: Who will revive these bones when they have rotted away?
78.yusuf_ali: And he makes comparisons for Us, and forgets his own (origin and) Creation: He says, "Who can give life to (dry) bones and decomposed ones (at that)?"
78.shakir: And he strikes out a likeness for Us and forgets his own creation. Says he: Who will give life to the bones when they are rotten?
78.muhammad_sarwar: He questions Our Resurrection of him, but has forgotten his own creation. He has said, "Who will give life to the bones which have become ashes?"
78.mohsin_khan: And he puts forth for Us a parable, and forgets his own creation. He says: "Who will give life to these bones when they have rotted away and became dust?"
78.arberry: And he has struck for Us a similitude and forgotten his creation; he says, 'Who shall quicken the bones when they are decayed?'

79.sahih_international: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."
79.pickthall: Say: He will revive them Who produced them at the first, for He is Knower of every creation,
79.yusuf_ali: Say, "He will give them life Who created them for the first time! for He is Well-versed in every kind of creation!-
79.shakir: Say: He will give life to them Who brought them into existence at first, and He is cognizant of all creation
79.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), tell him, "He who gave them life in the first place will bring them back to life again. He has the best knowledge of all creatures.
79.mohsin_khan: Say: (O Muhammad SAW) "He will give life to them Who created them for the first time! And He is the All-Knower of every creation!"
79.arberry: Say: 'He shall quicken them, who originated them the first time; He knows all creation,

80.sahih_international: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.
80.pickthall: Who hath appointed for you fire from the green tree, and behold! ye kindle from it.
80.yusuf_ali: "The same Who produces for you fire out of the green tree, when behold! ye kindle therewith (your own fires)!
80.shakir: He Who has made for you the fire (to burn) from the green tree, so that with it you kindle (fire).
80.muhammad_sarwar: He has created fire for you out of the green tree from which you can kindle other fires.
80.mohsin_khan: He, Who produces for you fire out of the green tree, when behold! You kindle therewith.
80.arberry: who has made for you out of the green tree fire and lo, from it you kindle.'

81.sahih_international: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.
81.pickthall: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the like of them? Aye, that He is! for He is the All-Wise Creator,
81.yusuf_ali: "Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like thereof?" - Yea, indeed! for He is the Creator Supreme, of skill and knowledge (infinite)!
81.shakir: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like of them? Yea! and He is the Creator (of all), the Knower.
81.muhammad_sarwar: Is the One who has created the heavens and the earth not able to create another creature like the human being? He certainly has the power to do so. He is the Supreme Creator and is All-knowing.
81.mohsin_khan: Is not He, Who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the like of them? Yes, indeed! He is the All-Knowing Supreme Creator.
81.arberry: Is not He, who created the heavens and earth, able to create the like of them? Yes indeed; He is the All-creator, the All-knowing.

82.sahih_international: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.
82.pickthall: But His command, when He intendeth a thing, is only that He saith unto it: Be! and it is.
82.yusuf_ali: Verily, when He intends a thing, His Command is, "be", and it is!
82.shakir: His command, when He intends anything, is only to say to it: Be, so it is.
82.muhammad_sarwar: Whenever He decides to create something He has only to say, "Exist," and it comes into existence.
82.mohsin_khan: Verily, His Command, when He intends a thing, is only that He says to it, "Be!" and it is!
82.arberry: His command, when He desires a thing, is to say to it 'Be,' and it is.

83.sahih_international: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
83.pickthall: Therefor Glory be to Him in Whose hand is the dominion over all things! Unto Him ye will be brought back.
83.yusuf_ali: So glory to Him in Whose hands is the dominion of all things: and to Him will ye be all brought back.
83.shakir: Therefore glory be to Him in Whose hand is the kingdom of all things, and to Him you shall be brought back.
83.muhammad_sarwar: All glory belongs to the One in whose hands is the control of all things. To Him you will all return.
83.mohsin_khan: So Glorified is He and Exalted above all that they associate with Him, and in Whose Hands is the dominion of all things, and to Him you shall be returned.
83.arberry: So glory be to Him, in whose hand is the dominion of everything, and unto whom you shall be returned.
